# Add global i18n configuration interface via environment variable ## Summary Implements issue #3264 by adding a global interface to change the i18n file used by CrewAI. Users can now set the `CREWAI_I18N_FILE` environment variable to specify a custom translation file path. The implementation follows a clear priority order: explicit `prompt_file` parameter → `CREWAI_I18N_FILE` environment variable → default `en.json`. **Key Changes:** - Modified `I18N` class to check `CREWAI_I18N_FILE` environment variable during initialization - Added Chinese (`zh.json`) and Spanish (`es.json`) translation files for testing and demonstration - Added comprehensive test coverage including error handling and priority verification - Fixed Python 3.10 compatibility issue with exception assertion patterns ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] **Security Review**: Verify that `CREWAI_I18N_FILE` environment variable doesn't allow path traversal attacks or access to sensitive files outside intended directories - [ ] **Translation Quality**: Review the Chinese (`zh.json`) and Spanish (`es.json`) translation files for accuracy and completeness - these contain agent prompts and error messages that directly affect AI behavior - [ ] **Manual Environment Variable Testing**: Test the priority order by setting `CREWAI_I18N_FILE` and verifying it overrides the default but not explicit `prompt_file` parameters - [ ] **Backward Compatibility**: Ensure existing code that doesn't use the environment variable continues to work exactly as before - [ ] **Edge Case Testing**: Test with invalid file paths, non-existent files, and files with malformed JSON to ensure proper error handling **Recommended Test Plan:** ```bash # Test 1: Default behavior (should work as before) unset CREWAI_I18N_FILE # Run existing CrewAI code, verify no changes # Test 2: Environment variable override export CREWAI_I18N_FILE=/path/to/zh.json # Verify Chinese translations are used # Test 3: Priority order export CREWAI_I18N_FILE=/path/to/zh.json # Use explicit prompt_file parameter, verify it takes precedence ``` --- ### Diagram ```mermaid %%{ init : { "theme" : "default" }}%% graph TD User["User Application"] I18N["src/crewai/utilities/
i18n.py"]:::major-edit EN["src/crewai/translations/

Environment Variable"]:::context User -->|"Creates I18N()"| I18N I18N -->|"1. Check explicit prompt_file"| I18N I18N -->|"2. Check CREWAI_I18N_FILE"| Env I18N -->|"3. Default fallback"| EN Env -.->|"Points to"| ZH Env -.->|"Points to"| ES Tests -->|"Validates"| I18N subgraph Legend L1["Major Edit"]:::major-edit L2["Minor Edit"]:::minor-edit L3["Context/No Edit"]:::context end classDef major-edit fill:#90EE90 classDef minor-edit fill:#87CEEB classDef context fill:#FFFFFF ``` ### Notes - **Python 3.10 Compatibility**: Fixed a specific issue where `pytest.raises(Exception, match="...")` wasn't working correctly in Python 3.10. Switched to `pytest.raises(Exception) as exc_info` with string assertion for better cross-version compatibility. - **File Structure**: New translation files follow the same structure as `en.json` with hierarchical manager agent prompts, slices, errors, and tools sections. - **No Breaking Changes**: The default behavior remains unchanged when no environment variable is set. **Session Details:** - Requested by: João (joao@crewai.com) - Devin Session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/d55077f3126d48bab98f1b01e966592a
